title: 3613. Minimize Maximum Component Cost

examples.explanation: Remove the edge between nodes 3 and 4 (weight 6). The resulting components have costs of 0 and 4, so the overall maximum cost is 4.
No edge can be removed, since allowing only one component (k = 1) requires the graph to stay fully connected. That single component’s cost equals its largest edge weight, which is 5.
